weaknesses: The abstract does not clearly articulate the significance of the Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition and its implications for convergence.
Numerical experiments lack a comprehensive comparison with existing methods to establish the claimed advantages.
The paper does not sufficiently address the limitations of the proposed approach, particularly regarding the initialization strategies.
strengths: The theoretical framework linking deep residual networks and neural ODEs is well-developed and provides new insights.
The paper presents rigorous proofs for the convergence of residual networks to neural ODEs under specific conditions.
Numerical experiments support the theoretical claims and demonstrate the practical applicability of the results.
